# Siphon

> Siphon is a media converter for Linux that converts video, audio, images and PDFs in place. It writes and verifies the output before consuming the source, so a 60 GB film can become an MP4 with a few hundred megabytes free.

Siphon is a single-binary CLI with an optional Dolphin ServiceMenu. It orchestrates `ffmpeg`, `ffprobe`, `lame`, `cwebp`, `dwebp`, `pdfinfo` and `pdftoppm`; it does not implement media codecs itself. It has no networking code, no telemetry and no accounts.

## The product

- Video default: MKV → MP4 in `relocate` mode, tail-first, one keyframe-aligned segment at a time. Peak extra space is one segment (typically 30–600 MB), not one film.
- Audio default: WAV → MP3 in `safe` mode (about 15% extra space). `reclaim` mode writes into the source head and needs about 1×, but is opt-in and can leave a ≤ 26 ms splice on a crash.
- Images, PDFs and the in-progress v0.2 pairs: `safe` only; peak space is source + output.
- Refusal is a first-class outcome: `siphon inspect` prints the plan and changes nothing.
- A crash leaves a recoverable state: destructive modes journal the plan. `siphon recover <file>` resumes exactly for video, splices for audio reclaim, and cleans up for safe modes.
- No silent quality loss: remux by default, metadata refusals rather than silent drops, explicit flags for lossy decisions.

## Formats

- MKV → MP4 (`relocate` default, `safe` for classic MP4)
- WAV → MP3 (`safe` default, `reclaim` opt-in)
- PNG ↔ JPG, PNG ↔ WebP, JPG ↔ WebP
- In progress for v0.2: PDF → PNG/JPG (one page only), PNG/JPG → PDF, MP4/MOV → MKV, MKV → MOV, WebM ↔ MP4, GIF ↔ MP4, video → MP3

## Space table

| Your MKV | Resolution / bitrate | Segment | Free needed | Total disk used |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 GB | 1080p, 10 Mbps | 60 s | ≈ 75 MB | ≈ 4.1 GB |
| 20 GB | 1080p, 20 Mbps | 60 s | ≈ 150 MB | ≈ 20.2 GB |
| 60 GB | 4K, 45 Mbps | 60 s | ≈ 340 MB | ≈ 60.3 GB |
| 60 GB | 4K, 45 Mbps | 15 s | ≈ 85 MB | ≈ 60.1 GB |
| 200 GB | 4K, 80 Mbps | 60 s | ≈ 600 MB | ≈ 200.6 GB |

Formula: `free = segment_duration × total_bitrate / 8 + 16 MB`.

## Limits

- Linux only. No Windows or macOS build.
- Video relocate is remux-only: one video plus one optional audio track, sized clusters, no transcoding. Classic MP4 requires `--mode safe` and 2× space.
- Relocate needs a filesystem with sparse files: ext4, btrfs, XFS. FAT32, exFAT and NTFS-3G are refused.
- No first-class GUI yet; the Dolphin ServiceMenu is the graphical surface.
- Packaging is planned; build from source today.
